    • 字段详细资料

      • autoUseCoupon

        @NameInMap(value="AutoUseCoupon")
public Boolean autoUseCoupon

        Specifies whether to automatically use coupons. Valid values:

        • true (default): Yes.
        • false: No.

        After a coupon is used, if a downgrade is required, the amount deducted by the coupon will not be refunded.

        example:

        true

      • burstingEnabled

        @NameInMap(value="BurstingEnabled")
public Boolean burstingEnabled

        Specifies whether to enable the I/O performance burst feature for Premium ESSD cloud disks. Valid values:

        • true: Enabled.
        • false: Disabled.
        example:

        false

      • category

        @NameInMap(value="Category")
public String category

        The instance edition. Valid values:

        • Basic: Basic Edition
        • HighAvailability: High-availability Edition
        • cluster: Cluster Edition
        example:

        Standard

      • coldDataEnabled

        @NameInMap(value="ColdDataEnabled")
public Boolean coldDataEnabled

        <props="china">Specifies whether to enable the data archiving feature for general cloud disks. Valid values:

        • <props="china">true: Enabled.

        • <props="china">false: Disabled.

        <props="intl">Reserved parameter.

        example:

        true

      • DBInstanceClass

        @NameInMap(value="DBInstanceClass")
public String DBInstanceClass

        The instance type. For more information, see Instance types.

        example:

        pg.n4.2c.1m

      • DBInstanceId

        @NameInMap(value="DBInstanceId")
public String DBInstanceId

        The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID.

        This parameter is required.

        example:

        pgm-bp15i4hn07r******

      • DBInstanceStorage

        @NameInMap(value="DBInstanceStorage")
public Integer DBInstanceStorage

        The target storage capacity. Unit: GB. You can call the DescribeAvailableClasses operation to query the available storage capacity range for the target instance type.

        • You must specify at least one of this parameter and the DBInstanceClass parameter.
        • You can call the DescribeDBInstanceAttribute operation to view the current storage capacity of the instance.
        example:

        500

      • DBInstanceStorageType

        @NameInMap(value="DBInstanceStorageType")
public String DBInstanceStorageType

        The instance storage type. Valid values:

        • general_essd: Premium ESSD (recommended)
        • cloud_essd: PL1 ESSD
        • cloud_essd2: PL2 ESSD
        • cloud_essd3: PL3 ESSD
        example:

        cloud_essd

      • DBNodes

        @NameInMap(value="DBNodes")
public List<ModifyDBInstanceRequest.ModifyDBInstanceRequestDBNodes> DBNodes

        The node information.

      • direction

        @NameInMap(value="Direction")
public String direction

        The type of specification change for the instance. Valid values:

        • Up (default): Upgrades a subscription instance, or upgrades or downgrades a pay-as-you-go instance.
        • Down: Downgrades a subscription instance.
        example:

        Up

      • effectiveTime

        @NameInMap(value="EffectiveTime")
public String effectiveTime

        The effective period for the new configurations. Valid values:

        Changing some configurations may affect the instance. Read the Impact section in the feature documentation carefully before you configure this parameter, and perform the operation during off-peak hours.

        • Immediate (default): Takes effect immediately.
        • MaintainTime: Takes effect within the maintenance window.
        • ScheduleTime: Specifies a time for the switchover. The time must be at least 12 hours later than the current time, and the actual switch time follows the formula: EffectiveTime = ScheduleTime + SwitchTime.
        example:

        Immediate

      • ioAccelerationEnabled

        @NameInMap(value="IoAccelerationEnabled")
public String ioAccelerationEnabled

        Specifies whether to enable the Buffer Pool Extension (BPE) feature for Premium ESSD cloud disks. Valid values:

        • 1: Enabled.
        • 0: Disabled.
        example:

        0

      • switchTime

        @NameInMap(value="SwitchTime")
public String switchTime

        Specifies the execution time for modifying the parameter. This parameter is required when EffectiveTime is set to ScheduleTime. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC time).

        The time must be later than the current time (the time when the API call is executed).

        example:

        2019-10-17T18:50:00Z

      • targetMinorVersion

        @NameInMap(value="TargetMinorVersion")
public String targetMinorVersion

        The minor engine version of the PostgreSQL instance. When you change the instance type and an error indicates that the minor engine version is not supported, you must specify this parameter to upgrade the minor engine version during the instance type change.

        Format: rds_postgres_<Major version number>00_<Minor version number>. Example for version 12 on 20200830: rds_postgres_1200_20200830.

        example:

        rds_postgres_1200_20200830
